title: Bamboo SUP load case
description: A scenario applied to a design: water, gravity, and the masses the object is asked to carry. Kept separate from design.json so a built prototype's design stays byte-stable across many test conditions. Same frame as the design it references.

condition_id.description: Identifier for this load case, e.g. C-rider-centred.

path.description: Optional path to the design file, relative to repository root.

density_kg_m3.description: 998 fresh at 20 C, 1025 typical seawater. Fresh is the conservative early workshop assumption.

surface.description: Only calm water is modelled. Wave cases require a schema revision, not a fudged value here.

loads.description: Everything carried but not permanently part of the object. An empty array is a valid unloaded case.

position.description: Centre of mass in the design frame. For a rider this is the standing CG, well above the deck.

solve.description: Which equilibrium degrees of freedom the solver is permitted to move. V0 solves heave only; heel and trim arrive in V2.

tolerance_n.description: Residual force tolerance for equilibrium, in newtons.

expectations.description: Optional hand-calculated or previously measured values this case is checked against. This is how a regression case or a prototype measurement is attached to a scenario without hiding a fudge factor in code.

source.description: measurement values are facts and must never be edited to match the model.

reference.description: Test log, protocol or derivation this came from.
